MaxLineLength:Strings.kt$AppStrings$"Packet logs live in memory only (500 entries by default, oldest evicted) and are never written to disk or uploaded automatically. MaxLineLength:Strings.kt$AppStrings$"Pick a device to connect. Pre-shared-key mode asks for the key; signed mode uses a device challenge. After authentication you can read info, configuration, and parameters."

Keep the device nearby and leave Bluetooth on during the update."

MaxLineLength:Strings.kt$AppStrings$"Reboot and factory reset require confirmation, and factory reset cannot be undone; heartbeat only reads uptime and battery. Confirm-token semantics must be confirmed with the firmware."
